Public Statement – Council Meeting Recording 23 July 2025

The Shire of Moora advises that it was not possible for Council to make a recording of the Ordinary Council Meeting held on 23 July 2025, or for any part of the meeting to be recorded using the local government’s recording technology.

At the time of the meeting, it was understood that the recording had been successfully commenced and concluded using the standard system. However, it has since been determined that no recording was captured due to a technical failure.

No improvised or alternative recording of the meeting was made. It was not reasonably practicable for the Shire to arrange such a recording, as a number of Councillors and staff were interstate or otherwise unavailable at the time, limiting the ability to implement alternative arrangements on short notice.

Council remains committed to transparency and regrets any inconvenience this may cause to community members seeking access to the recording.

18 June 2025 - Ordinary Meeting of Council

Wednesday, June 18, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers, rear of Administration building, cnr Padbury & Clinch Streets, Moora

Public Statement – Council Meeting Recording 18 June 2025

The Shire of Moora advises that it was not possible for Council to make a recording of the Ordinary Council Meeting held on 18 June 2025, or for any part of the meeting to be recorded using the local government’s recording technology.

At the time of the meeting, it was understood that the recording had been successfully commenced and concluded using the standard system. However, it has since been determined that no recording was captured due to a technical failure.

No improvised or alternative recording of the meeting was made. It was not reasonably practicable for the Shire to arrange such a recording, as a number of Councillors and staff were interstate or otherwise unavailable at the time, limiting the ability to implement alternative arrangements on short notice.

Council remains committed to transparency and regrets any inconvenience this may cause to community members seeking access to the recording.

Council Meetings

2026 Council Meeting Schedule

Ordinary Council Meetings will be held on the fourth Wednesday of the month, with the exceptions of January (when no meeting will be held) and December (when the meeting will be held on the second Wednesday of the month). The meeting schedule for 2026 is as follows:

  • 25 February 2026
  • 25 March 2026
  • 21 April 2026 - Annual Electors Meeting - held at the Moora Performing Arts Centre.
  • 22 April 2026
  • 27 May 2026
  • 24 June 2026
  • 22 July 2026
  • 26 August 2026
  • 23 September 2026
  • 28 October 2026
  • 25 November 2026
  • 9 December 2026

Council meetings are held in the Council Chambers, located at the rear of the Shire administration building, on the corner of Padbury and Clinch Streets, commencing at 5.30pm, unless stated otherwise.

Council meetings are open to the public, who are welcome to attend.
